what: The Working Days Calculator counts business days between two dates, leaving out weekends and the holidays you list. Weekends differ around the world, so you choose them: Saturday and Sunday, Friday and Saturday, Friday only, Sunday only, or any days you tick.
It also does the reverse: add a number of working days to a date to find a deadline. Results update as you type and everything stays on your device.
uses: Find how many working days are left before a launch.
Count paid working days and hours in a month.
See how many working days a holiday trip uses.
Add 10 business days to an order date.
Count notice periods measured in working days.
tutorial: Choose the start and end dates. If the end is before the start, they are swapped for you.
Both dates are counted by default. Untick "Count the start date" or "Count the end date" if you need to.
Choose a weekend from the list, or tick the day buttons for a custom weekend.
Type or paste one date per line, such as 2026-12-25 Christmas, 25/12/2026 or 25 Dec 2026.
Change "Hours per working day" to see total working hours.
In the second section, pick a start date and the number of working days to add (or a negative number to go back).
features: Presets for common weekends plus fully custom days.
Several date formats, with a name after the date if you like.
Holidays on a weekend are not subtracted twice.
Multiply working days by hours per day.
Find a business-day deadline from any date.
Works even if you enter the later date first.

example.title: Worked example: November 2026
example.text: Start 1 November 2026, end 30 November 2026, weekend Saturday and Sunday: 30 calendar days, 9 weekend days and 21 working days, or 168 hours at 8 hours a day. Add 2026-11-26 as a holiday and the answer drops to 20. Switch the weekend to Friday and Saturday and the same month has 22 working days.

tips: Paste your country's public holiday list once a year and keep it in a note for next time.
Write dates as YYYY-MM-DD to avoid confusion between day-first and month-first formats.
Slash dates are read day first (25/12/2026), as in most of the world.
For calendar days only, use the Days Between Dates tool.
problems: It could not read a holiday line
Use a format like 2026-12-25 or 25 Dec 2026. The message names the line number.
Check whether the start and end dates should be counted, and untick them if not.
It says there are no working days
Every day is ticked as a weekend. Untick at least one day.
